[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 60
- Description: Diagnosed and fixed oracle.truesight.me chart-cast failure. Root cause: qimen-dunjia 2.1.0 ships a simplified-to-traditional Chinese conversion map for solar terms with only 3 entries (谷雨/惊蛰/处暑). Missing 小满 to 小滿 and 芒种 to 芒種. The downstream lookup uses traditional keys; when the lunar library hands back simplified 小满 for any day in the 小滿 window the conversion silently fails and the library throws unknown 節氣, breaking castQmdjChart and surfacing as 'Could not compute the QiMen chart for this moment.' Today 2026-05-21 is the first day of 小滿 so this hit production. The same bug would have re-broken the site around June 5 when 芒種 starts (also missing). Fix: vendored the upstream bundle locally to oracle/assets/vendor/qimen-dunjia/qimen.standalone.patched.min.js, injected the two missing entries into the minified SIMPLIFIED_TO_TRADITIONAL literal, rest byte-identical to the CDN copy. Updated index.html to load the local file instead of the CDN. Re-vendor instructions inline. Verified by running generateChartByDatetime('2026052112') which now returns 陽遁5局 節氣:小滿 as expected. Shipped via oracle PR 21, merged, GitHub Pages auto-deployed, live HTTP 200 confirmed. Investigation steps recorded for future: trace ran via console.warn output to castQmdjChart, then Node install of the library locally, then grep through calculations.js to find s2t() and the partial map, then unicode-escape literal patching in the minified bundle.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
--------
